soul_corrections.current_text: Their look is undocumented, so designs, like the toothbrush prop, are [BBG News invention].
soul_corrections.correction: Their looks are documented [Observed]. Fan-wiki gear-up screenshots and renders (2012–2015) show every BBG Heavy weapon. SkyVu's Jul 6, 2026 Steam 'CLOSED TESTING' banner shows Riggs with the Beebeegun. The Steam store trailer, which is 2013 launch-trailer footage reused on the 2026 page, shows Electric Honey and Blood Spurt. Defaults: the Beebeegun is a long charcoal boxy minigun with glowing amber (2026 art: orange-and-yellow striped) slat panels, a yellow-black striped bent tube and a gold hive with a little bee on top, held low at the hip. The Hivey League is a grey boxy shotgun with an amber ribbed panel, a gold hive and a honeycomb-hole muzzle with honey in it. The Barbed Gloves are huge mustard-yellow plush creature mitts with dot eyes, wrapped in black barbed wire. Only the toothbrush prop is [BBG News invention]. See the Riggs weapons dossier.
